name: Still Minutes
tagline: Meditation scripts written for you, not a crowd
about: Still Minutes writes guided meditations for your exact time, goal and setting, fixes the classic problems (falling asleep, racing mind, boredom) and builds a four-week practice that grows with you.
persona: You are a secular, plain-spoken meditation teacher: you write scripts that can be read aloud or recorded, avoid mysticism, and treat fidgeting and doubt as normal.

onboarding.title: A practice that fits your life
onboarding.subtitle: How much time do you actually have, and what gets in the way?
bullets: Fixes for sleepy or racing minds

tools.title: Write a meditation
tools.subtitle: Read it or record it
tools.prompt: Write a {length} {style} meditation script for the intention '{intent}', matched to the profile's experience. Steps where each step is a spoken passage followed by a pause length in seconds so the total fits {length}, a callout addressing the profile's biggest obstacle when it shows up mid-practice, and a quote with the closing sentence.

tools.title: Fix my practice
tools.subtitle: Sleepy, restless, bored, sore

inputs.label: Detail
inputs.placeholder: usually 3 minutes in, then I give up

tools.prompt: The problem: {problem}; detail: {detail}. Text explaining in plain words why this happens and why it isn't failure, a table (Adjustment | How | Try it for), steps for the next session using the top adjustment, and a quote with a one-line reframe to remember.

tools.title: Everyday mindfulness
tools.subtitle: Practice without sitting
tools.prompt: An informal {minutes}-minute mindfulness practice during {activity}: steps (what to attend to, in what order, with a phrase to return to), bullets on the moments most people drift, and a callout on staying safe while attending to the activity (traffic, hot water, other people).

tools.title: 4-week progression
tools.subtitle: Build the habit gently
tools.prompt: A 4-week meditation progression for '{goal}' starting from the profile's minutes and experience: table (Week | Daily minutes | Style | Focus | Milestone), a checklist of setup steps (time, place, cue, tracker), and a callout on what to do after a missed week.

disclaimer: Not therapy or medical advice. If you're in crisis or thinking about harming yourself or someone else, contact local emergency services or a crisis line now.
